name: swarm
test_cmd: mkdir -p "$ENV/home" "$ENV/tmp" && HOME="$ENV/home" TMPDIR="$ENV/tmp" $PY -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/
notes: No CI config in the repo (no .github/), so I picked 3.11 (python_requires >=3.10). The test command is the inventory's `pytest tests/` from the repo root. pytest comes from install_requires, so no extras are needed. All 6 tests (test_core 4, test_util 2) use an injected MockOpenAIClient. No network, no API key, nothing deselected. Resolved openai==3.3.0 (instructor caps it), instructor==1.17.0. Common: setup runs from the router-migrate root (each step sources scripts/env.sh so uv caches/Pythons stay in .tools); --exclude-newer 2026-10-13T00:00:00Z pins dependency resolution to the baseline date. test_cmd sandboxes HOME and TMPDIR into $ENV/home and $ENV/tmp so tests never read or write the real ~ (e.g. ~/.config) or /tmp. Baseline was taken with outbound network denied (macOS sandbox-exec, loopback allowed), so the tests are confirmed offline. Rebuilt from scratch into a second env (<name>-check): identical uv pip freeze and identical counts. Check-run counts: 6 passed in 1.26s (1.7s).
